pilot_rule: Equilibrium and lowest selected original state ID in nominal-safe, challenging-safe, and PD-unsafe groups
objective: sum(theta[t]^2 + 0.1*omega[t]^2 + 0.001*u[t]^2), t=0..199; no terminal cost or safety penalties
transcription: Direct multiple shooting: physical x[1:201] and u[0:200]; fixed exact x[0]; hard raw-state and torque bounds; smooth dynamics equivalent on the feasible domain
acceptance: Only an independent 200-step Gymnasium trajectory and bitwise recorded-action replay with minimum raw margin >= 0 count as a witness; solver status is separate
solver_repetition: Repeat all 12 pilot solves with identical initialization and settings; preserve both attempts
candidate_policy: Evaluate each final finite candidate, including nonconverged or timed-out last iterates; preserve missing candidates and failed runs
oracle_ranking: Within each mode, highest replay minimum margin, then highest return, then earliest start index; retain all outcomes
